newsitem.title: USA: Coke earnings come amid strong global volume.
newsitem.headline: Coke earnings come amid strong global volume.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co reported fourth-quarter and full-year earnings in-line with analysts' estimates amid strong worldwide unit volume for the company's products.

The company said it earned $0.31 per share for the quarter, compared with $0.26 per share in the year-ago quarter. It also said it earned $1.40 per share for all of 1996, compared with $1.18 per share for 1995.
The company was expected to earn $0.31 per share for the quarter and $1.40 per share for the year, according to the mean estimate from analysts surveyed by First Call.
